assessment: In this article, Olive and colleagues used a genetic screen to identify complex I (CI) of the electron transport chain (ETC) as a regulator of IFNγ-mediated gene expression in macrophages. They attribute this role of CI to effects on the activity of the JAK-STAT pathway downstream of the IFNγ receptor. That CI (or perhaps ETC) activity can acutely regulate JAK-STAT signaling has interesting implications for the metabolic regulation of signal transduction, and the underpinning basis would be important to elucidate in future studies.
